summary: Wrist restraints: two hinged steel cuffs and a short chain, worn at the small of the back. options channel0, channel1; sockets grip_r, grip_l, holster_r, sling_back.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.garment_overlay_cuffs or place "prefab": "garment_overlay_cuffs" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
